scripts.docker:up:external-db: bash scripts/docker-local-stack.sh up -d --build --no-deps governance-platform authd api-proxy worker-agent task-board caddy
scripts.build:services: npm --prefix services/arena-runner run build && npm --prefix services/worker-agent run build
scripts.proxy: bash -lc 'set -a; source apps/governance-platform/.env; [ -f apps/governance-platform/.env.local ] && source apps/governance-platform/.env.local; set +a; npm --prefix services/api-proxy run start'
scripts.tasks: cd apps/task-board && PORT=${PORT:-3001} npx next dev --port ${PORT:-3001}
scripts.a2e:studio: cd apps/a2e-studio && PORT=${PORT:-3003} npx next dev --port ${PORT:-3003}
scripts.test:ui:e2e:budget: bash -lc 'PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL=${PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL:-http://localhost:3010} PORT=${PORT:-3010} PLAYWRIGHT_DATABASE_URL=${PLAYWRIGHT_DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://ralph:ralph@localhost:5434/ralph_arena_e2e} npm --prefix apps/governance-platform run test:e2e:budget'
